for the SPEC-0001 increment 18 RED tests. `alpha.c` and `beta.c` are byte-equal
to the first reads of the increment-14 mini fixture

(dense under the tinyllama2 test vocab, so a repeat fits its 2048-token slot).
No production traffic,
no real repository, no real session.
